title: Ghost challenges: medals, Rival ghost, weekly challenge
summary: Lap Attack now has medals, a ghost picker (Off, PB, next medal, Rival, #1) and a Weekly Challenge with a live percentile.
details: Medals: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Author at 150, 120, 106 and 100 percent of the author time. Results reveal the medal coin with NEW; course cards and the Profile show coins.
Ghost row: PB, the next medal's ghost, Rival (the stored ghost just above you) and #1. The Worker keeps the ten best ghosts plus one per band of five ranks down to rank 40.

Weekly Challenge: one seeded track per ISO week, full race, no CPUs. The page shows time left, your best, percentile and the top ten. Badges (Top 1/10/25/50 percent, Finished) are given once a week's cuts are final.
Note: research/GHOST_CHALLENGES.md. PRs #642 (Worker side) and #657 (game side), part of #631.

Verification: 76 Worker tests, focused game unit tests, and tools/test_engine_ghost_challenges.mjs against a local Worker over SQLite. Host-only evidence: browser tests on host Chromium against a local game server. Nothing was checked on physical phones.
limitation: No human lap was measured, so how hard the medals are for a person is untested; author times come from the game's own driver. The weekly 'no CPUs' rule is enforced by the client only. Not run against production D1. The Rival-race capture showed no visible ghost, so it is not published.
